title: Strategy register with two-sided change tests
rule: Every row carries promote_if and demote_if. A row with only one side is not publishable here. Parlays/SGP/props are listed with n = 0 and no definition because G6 blocks them.

reward_policy.why: No strategy passes G1 (n >= 300) or G2 (Brier-skill lower bound above 0), so no reward can be earned. A reward paid on accuracy or on an assumed-price ROI would reward luck.
reward_policy.would_pay_if: a strategy clears G1 and G2 and survives G7 for four consecutive weeks
reward_policy.control_exclusion: S3, S4, C1 are controls and are never eligible for a reward

paired_vs_control.note: If this interval contains 0, the model has not been shown to beat a trivial picking-the-better-record rule on this sample, whatever its absolute accuracy.

multiplicity.note: S1 and S2 are two looks at one model; a Bonferroni-style adjustment for m=2 is m=2, and the larger m that matters is the number of namespaces in this repository that have fitted a model to the same season.

strategies.name: Model favourite (singles, shadow)
strategies.definition: Bet the club the rating model makes the favourite. Decision uses the model's own probability only; no price input.
promote_if: n reaches 300 graded games (G1) and the week-cluster lower bound on Brier skill stays above 0
the paired difference against the record-only control excludes 0 on a larger sample
demote_if: the Brier-skill lower bound is at or below 0 for 4 consecutive weeks (G7)
the paired difference against S3 falls below 0 on a larger sample
strategies.what_would_change_our_mind: Right now: a lower bound of -0.0148 on Brier skill means the model has NOT been shown to beat a coin flip with confidence, while a model-free rule scores within 2.6 points of it. If 184 more graded games keep the lower bound below 0, this strategy is dead and should be withdrawn rather than tuned.

strategies.name: Model favourite, high confidence (singles, shadow)
strategies.definition: S1 restricted to fixtures where the model's own probability is at least 0.65.
promote_if: n reaches 300 and the lower bound stays above 0 after the multiplicity adjustment for 2 registered singles strategies
demote_if: G7 as S1; or the confidence bucket's calibration bin stays inverted (no higher hit rate than the 0.50-0.60 bin) as n grows
strategies.what_would_change_our_mind: The 0.60-0.70 bin currently observes 41.7% home wins against 64.4% predicted — one bin, 12 games. If that inversion survives 50 more games, the 0.65 threshold is selecting the model's worst probabilities, not its best, and S2 must be withdrawn.

strategies.name: Better-record rule (CONTROL, not a candidate)
strategies.definition: Pick the club with the better wins-minus-losses record computed from games before the cutoff. Zero model content.
promote_if: never — a control cannot be promoted; it exists to make the model prove itself
strategies.what_would_change_our_mind: This control is the reason the model's headline accuracy is not treated as evidence: they differ by 2.6 points with an interval of [-3.7, +8.5]. If this control ever beats the model on a larger sample, the ratings are not earning their complexity.

strategies.name: Fade of S1 (registered falsification test)
strategies.definition: Bet the opposite of S1. If the model were noise, this would score about the same.
promote_if: never — a fade scoring well is evidence the original score is noise
strategies.what_would_change_our_mind: 32.2% accuracy when inverted, against 67.8% for the original, is the shape you want: the original is not symmetric noise.

strategies.name: Coin flip (control baseline)
strategies.definition: A fair coin per fixture, 2 000 repeated runs.
strategies.what_would_change_our_mind: Nothing: it is the null the whole page is measured against.

strategies.name: Parlays, same-game parlays, prop combos
strategies.definition: Not defined on purpose: a combination cannot be ranked without a validated joint probability and the operator's void/push rules.
promote_if: a validated joint distribution for the exact leg set, and the operator's void/push rules published on the row
strategies.what_would_change_our_mind: CR-03 shows a same-game scoring dependence of r = 0.053 (n = 296, interval includes 0) — too weak to justify independence and too imprecise to justify dependence. Multiplying marginal probabilities stays forbidden until a joint number exists.
